Name: TestSprite 4.0
Tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

Name: Tabstack by Mozilla
Tagline: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy
Description: Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

Name: Room AI
Tagline: Talk to it like a designer. Your room, one change at a time
Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Home improvement, Interior design
Description: Upload a photo of your room and say what you'd change. Each reply is a new photo of your room with that change made and the rest left as it was. Every version kept, compare any two. No credits to count. Try it on your room first, no card.

Name: Verse Engine by Ctruh
Tagline: Blender, Unity or Unreal to a live 3D link in one click
Description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.

Name: Every Signal
Tagline: Diligence on any company in an hour, every number sourced
Description: Every Signal's research agents take a company and a question and return a sourced teardown: traffic, ads, tracking stack, pricing, revenue math, competitors and rules. Every figure is tagged verified, estimate, inferred or rumour. Then it watches for changes.

Name: Gemini 4 Neon
Tagline: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
Description: Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

Name: Manufact
Tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
Description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

Name: The Calm Creator Mastermind
Tagline: For solopreneurs who are tired of being solo.
Description: This is a small mastermind for creators, community builders, and indie founders who want to grow their business on their own terms, design a life they love, and treat their nervous system as a core measure of success alongside revenue. Other masterminds focus on growth at all costs. In this group, we're much more conscious of those costs. We commit to living a calm, balanced, and integrated life while growing the businesses and lives of our dreams.

Name: Stripo Email Widgets
Tagline: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding
Topics: Design Tools, Email Marketing, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

Name: Netlify Server
Tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
Description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

Name: Teaflask
Tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
Topics: SaaS, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

Name: Spellar for Chrome
Tagline: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser
Description: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

Name: Adside
Tagline: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you
Description: A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

Name: Cleared
Tagline: Your personal plan to give up vapes, pouches and cigarettes
Description: Most people who quit nicotine try without a plan. Cleared builds one from what you use, then helps every day: a check-in, a daily coach, one-tap logging and Craving SOS for the hard moments. Took a home nicotine test? Snap a photo and AI reads the result.

Name: Tecla
Tagline: A proactive AI agent whose interface is a TODO list
Description: Tecla is a proactive AI assistant for work. It finds everything that's on your plate and turns it into a curated TODO list. You can click any item and Tecla does it for you. No prompts and no more text threads. You will never leave anything behind again. Just chat with people on Slack, exchange emails, have meetings, and tecla will understand what has to be done from those and surface the work, with all the required context.

Name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
Tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
Description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

Name: HeyGen Avatar 6
Tagline: AI Avatar Model That Looks Like You
Description: Avatar 6 is HeyGen’s most realistic AI avatar model, 84.4% indistinguishable from real footage. Your first video is free.

Name: mio click
Tagline: A fidget that's also a friend
Description: mio click is a handheld clicker with one mechanical button and a tiny screen. Hatch a Squig, Goober or Meatball. No two are the same, and yours moves every time you press. It counts every click anywhere you take it, then syncs over Wi-Fi to a public leaderboard where you can see how your mio ranks, hatch a new one or swap with a friend. Assembled by hand in small batches by a team of parents. The button is rated for 50 million clicks.

Name: Alfred 6
Tagline: Supercharging macOS since 2010
Description: Alfred 6 brings Alfred UI, a new macOS-native toolkit creators can use to build lightweight workflows with real interfaces. Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

Name: Upsolve MCP Connections
Tagline: Plug Notion, Linear and more into your data agent
Description: Attach any MCP server to your Upsolve agent. Your agent still answers from governed warehouse data, and can now read and write where your team works: save an analysis to Notion, open a Linear ticket, pull context from docs.
